svg.title: RAG PDF GENIE
svg.desc: RAG PDF Genie: a local retrieval-augmented generation demo. A 115-page IRS PDF is chunked into ChromaDB with nomic-embed-text; a multi-query retriever rewrites the question and llama3.2 via Ollama answers from the retrieved context only. Python, LangChain, Streamlit. No API keys.
